## A review on how Aloha Medicinals was able to organically cultivate the most potent Cordyceps in
## the world that is not only bio-identical genetically, but also bio-identical in it’s analytical
## signature.

Cordyceps has been used for a long time in China and Tibet. For at least a thousand years according
to the written record. It was not until 1972 that the first successful Cordyceps cultivation was
achieved. The first Cordyceps cultures were isolated by the Chinese Academy of Sciences in that
year. These strains were not isolated from Tibet, where most of the top quality Cordyceps comes
from, but rather they were isolated from specimens found in Qinghai province in Central China.
Originally three different strains of Cordyceps were isolated. The first three strains, named CS-1,
CS-2 and CS-3, did not have the fast growth characteristics that make commercial cultivation
practical. It was the fourth culture that had been isolated by this institute, named CS-4, that was
hardy and fast growing. So this CS-4 strain was chosen for commercial production.
This CS-4 culture proved itself a good candidate for commercial growth, so it was evaluated as a
substitute for wild Cordyceps. It was tested for its medical potential, and by 1988 it had been
approved in China as a medicine under the name Jin Shui Bao. As part of the approval process to
bring this to market, many clinical and safety trials were conducted showing its efficacy and
safety. That is the reason there are so many scientific articles available on this particular strain
called CS-4.

But that happened a long time ago in terms of science. Think of the advances that have been made in
all the sciences over the last 44 years. That is how long ago CS-4 was isolated. CS-4 is a good
dietary supplement, but just because CS-4 was the first Cordyceps cultivated and studied certainly
does not mean it is still the best choice today, yet many people today are taken in by the marketers
that still use that early information on CS-4, telling their customers that CS-4 is the best
Cordyceps for their use. This is just simply incorrect. Back in 1972 when CS-4 was isolated there
was no such thing as DNA analysis. So at that time it was not realized that CS-4 contained only a
part of the Cordyceps genome. CS-4 is closely related to Cordyceps sinensis, but it is not “true
Cordyceps sinensis”. CS-4 is a related species called an Anamorph.

Let’s jump ahead nearly 40 years and look at where Cordyceps cultivation is today: Aloha Medicinals
set out to cultivate the most potent Cordyceps back in 1999. Aloha started with the purchase of CS-4
cultures from private manufacturers in China. This was the first strain of Cordyceps Aloha produced
when the company was formed on Maui in 2000. In 2001 Aloha purchased another ten Cordyceps strains
from the Government of China. But Alohas research using DNA analysis and the most up-to-date
analytical methods such as GC/MS and HPLC/MS showed that none of these “Cordyceps” strains were
identical to wild Cordyceps. They were all related anamorphs, but they were not “True Cordyceps”.

Aloha tried every possible combination of culture techniques and growth medium, but realized that by
using these part-spore cultures there was no way to gain the full potential which is known to occur
in wild Cordyceps. To achieve the wild Cordyceps quality requires a much more complex approach,
involving the replication of the wild Cordyceps growth conditions and triggering fusion between
several part-spore cultures to achieve the full Cordyceps DNA sequence. This approach was so unique
it was issued the only patent ever granted for the hybridization of mushrooms! **This is the only
cultivated Cordyceps available today that is genetically and analytically Bio-Identical to the wild
Cordyceps occurring in Nature.** This is not to be confused with Genetic Modification. Aloha
Medicinals absolutely guarantees there are NO genetically modified organisms (GMO) in any Aloha
Medicinals product. Aloha is opposed to the GMO approach, as well as this being forbidden under USDA
and EU Certified Organic standards. Quality has no substitute. **Aloha Medicinals makes the VERY
BEST medicinal mushroom products in the world today**

Even after Aloha had developed these bio-identical cultures though, which were 100% Cordyceps
sinensis in every way, there was still a problem: The Cordyceps being grown in cultivation was still
not as potent as the wild collected Cordyceps. To try and resolve this problem, **Aloha Medicinals
scientists undertook an expedition into the heartland of wild Cordyceps habitat, central Tibet.** In
May and June of 2006 Aloha Medicinals conducted one of the most comprehensive scientific research
expeditions ever undertaken in the mountains of Tibet to study the natural growth parameters of wild
Cordyceps. Working with the local nomad people, Aloha identified several hundred Cordyceps specimens
growing directly from the ground. Aloha carefully measured all the growth conditions there, such as
pH, soil and air temperature and composition, moisture content in the air and soil, the other
micro-organisms found in the area, air pressure and virtually everything else that could be
measured, Aloha did.

Aloha brought this information back to the lab, and developed entirely new methods of cultivation,
which have resulted in Cordyceps that is not only bio-identical genetically, but also bio-identical
in it’s analytical signature. Bringing the latest of 21st century American biotechnology to this
field has resulted in a quantum leap in Cordyceps cultivation, reducing the cost and increasing the
quality of cultivated Cordyceps. **These cultivation methods involved building special growing
chambers where the oxygen is held at 50% of the normal atmospheric oxygen, and the temperature is
held at just above freezing. This exactly replicates the conditions found during the growing season
in Nepal and Tibet at 18,000 feet (5400 meters) elevation. This Low Temperature, Low Oxygen growth
is also patented. Aloha Medicinals is the only company in the world that grows Cordyceps using these
techniques.**

  * ## About Oriveda
    
    Oriveda® is originally a Dutch brand but registered worldwide as a trademark. Its focus is on
    selling well-researched functional mushroom extracts of superior quality.
    
    Oriveda® has been in business since 2010, making it one of the most experienced and reliable
    online sellers of functional mushroom extracts.
    
    The Oriveda® brand guarantees you get premium well-tested products, excellent value-for-money
    and 100% service. We are shipping our products fast and efficient *-worldwide=* using our
    logistic hub in Hong Kong.
    
    As can be expected from a Dutch brand, **we are a no-nonsense business**. Logic, common sense
    and pragmatism are leading. A simple example is this: quality and safety claims should be backed
    up with hard verifiable facts. Lab tests.
    
    This seems self-evident, but in fact there are very few sellers that can show you **objective
    proof of their claimed quality and safety**. The harsh truth is that most sellers prefer to
    invest in marketing, not in good products or quality control. [Recent research][6] found that ±
    89% of supplements do not contain what is claimed on the label and many contain prohibited
    ingredients. **Our products are tested by independent third party laboratories**, not just for
    safety but in particular for mushroom-specific marker compounds. After all, these compounds
    determine the therapeutic potential.
    
    **Potency and safety are key!** You don't have to take our word for it when we claim premium
    quality - you can actually verify it.
    
    We share all our test reports with our customers - check the link below.

    up with hard verifiable facts. Lab tests.

## Tap into the future of pet nutrition with insect-based protein

Your browser does not support the video tag.

### Dry & wet pet food

The future of feeding: eco-friendly, effective, and engineered with care.
Consistent nutrition

Stable nutritional value in every batch. Our processes deliver proteins with precise amino acid
profiles, supporting pet health across applications.

Palatability

Our mealworm-based proteins ensure pets enjoy every meal. Naturally appealing and easy to digest,
they enhance flavor and texture in both dry and wet foods.

[
Learn more
][21]
Your browser does not support the video tag.

### Veterinary and functional diets

A perfect base for veterinary and functional diets, our insect protein meets the needs of sensitive
pets.
Hypoallergenic properties

Lesser mealworm proteins help reduce skin allergies, with studies showing improvements in up to 60%
of dogs with atopic dermatitis.

Digestive and healthy

Insect-based diets support healthy skin, joints and coats by providing essential nutrients like
omega fatty acids. Easily digestible and suitable for pets with sensitive dietary requirements.

[
Learn more
][22]
Your browser does not support the video tag.

## Sustainability is no longer optional–it’s essential

[
Discover Sustainability
][23]

## Through our process, each tonne of sidestream material utilized reduces CO2 emissions by 860 kg.

It’s All About The Sustainability

## Patented feeding, AI-driven facilities, and closed-loop systems: scaling operations without
## increasing environmental impact

[
Symbiosis with mushroom industry

We taught insects to love mushrooms. This eco-forward method means no strain on local resources, no
seasonal limitations, and a reliable, non-GMO protein supply year-round.

][24][
Lower land and water use

We turn agricultural byproducts into feed and frass fertilizer. This closed-loop approach cuts
waste, uses 90x less land, and 5x less water than livestock farming.

][25][
Lower carbon emission

Our facilities run on green energy and AI optimization. With light-free rearing and local sourcing,
we’re targeting less than 1 kg CO₂e per kilogram of protein.

][26]

As the demand for greener, healthier pet food rises, our insect-based proteins provide the
innovation your brand needs to lead the market. Connect with us to explore opportunities for
partnership.

### Производство

**Охватывает полный набор материалов для выращивания грибов**: автоматизированное оборудование для
выращивания, интеллектуальные системы контроля окружающей среды теплиц, селекция и НИОКР штаммов,
культуральная среда, покровная почва, вспомогательные тепличные сооружения, вентиляционные и
увлажняющие устройства. Связывает крупные промышленные грибные фермы, посадочные базы и фабричных
производителей по всему миру для получения комплексных современных решений по выращиванию.

### Международная торговля

Собирает покупателей из более чем 20 стран и регионов. Из регионов инициативы «Пояс и путь»,
платформ трансграничной электронной коммерции, импортеров и экспортеров, покупателей супермаркетов и
дистрибьюторов цепочек поставок общественного питания. Демонстрирует свежие грибы, сушеные грибы,
оптовые сырьевые материалы и подарочные наборы, строит двусторонние внутренние и зарубежные каналы
продаж для расширения глобальных заказов.

мгновенные грибные закуски, грибные приправы, экстракты грибов для здоровья и функциональные
съедобные грибные продукты. Связывает производителей продуктов питания, бренды здорового питания и
команды НИОКР общественного питания для освоения высокодоходных возможностей рынка глубокой

RYZE FAQs

## Frequently Asked

## Questions
* ### How much caffeine is in the product?
  
  A cup of our mushroom coffee medium roast contains about 48mg of caffeine, less than half the
  amount that’s in a regular cup of coffee. To sustain energy naturally and get rid of the jitters,
  we look to Cordyceps, not caffeine. A cup of mushroom coffee dark roast has 80-90mg of caffeine
  per serving which is comparable to a traditional cup of coffee. It delivers a bold coffee
  experience, with whole-body benefits.
* ### Are there any additives or sweeteners?
  
  Absolutely none.
* ### Can you consume while pregnant or breastfeeding?
  
  While it is perfectly safe to consume our product during pregnancy or while breastfeeding, we
  always recommend consulting with your physician before repeated use. 
* ### When is the best time to consume Ryze?
  
  We may be biased because we like to drink RYZE all day long. However, we recommend it first thing
  in the morning to get your energy levels up, your focus turned ON, and your happiness at an all
  time high. It's the perfect way to start the day. It also works amazing as an
  afternoon-pick-me-up. Not at all harsh like coffee, its calm energy takes you smoothly right into
  the evening hours.
* ### Does mushroom coffee contain coffee?
  
  Yes! Our shade-grown, organic arabica coffee is grown in Mexico. After carefully roasting and
  brewing the beans, our coffee is spray-dried into a pure instant powder before being added to our
  formula. It yields just 48mg of caffeine per cup of medium roast, and 80-90mg per cup of dark
  roast.
* ### Where do you ship?
  
  We currently ship domestically in the US only. We are working on expanding our shipping options as
  soon as possible to offer RYZE to mushroom coffee fans worldwide.
* ### Where is it made?
  
  Our company is based in Boston, MA, but our organic mushrooms are sustainably grown in California
  and Nevada. The other ingredients are sourced from the best suppliers in the country, being
  thoroughly tested for mycotoxins and heavy metals. We ship from our warehouse in Texas straight to
  your front door.
* ### What are the differences between mushroom coffee and regular coffee?
  
  Benefits. Benefits. Benefits. With less than half the amount of caffeine in normal coffee,
  mushroom coffee offers a plethora of health benefits like calmer, sharper focus, no jitters,
  sustained energy without the crash, immune support, gut health and a calm digestive tract. In
  addition, functional mushrooms offer benefits to optimize body and brain function due to them
  being antioxidants, anti-virals, and anti-microbials.
* ### Are functional mushrooms the same as magic mushrooms? Will they make me trip?
  
  While we think the mushrooms in our blend are perfectly magical due to their health benefits, no
  they are not psychedelic or magic mushrooms and they will not make you trip. With over 10,000
  species of mushrooms out there, medicinal (or functional mushrooms) are distinct from magic and
  have absolutely no psychedelic effects whatsoever.
* ### Are you certified gluten-free? Vegan?
  
  We are currently working on getting certified gluten free and vegan but we can absolutely assure
  you that all of our ingredients are gluten free and vegan.
* ### Are you organic?
  
  Our mushroom blend and our fiber blend are 100% organic.
* ### How should I use it?
  
  RYZE is a ready to drink beverage. Stir it into 8-10 oz. of hot water or use a mini-frother to
  make it extra foamy and frothy! Nut and non-dairy milks blend very nicely for an even creamier
  texture. Add natural sweeteners to taste.

  addition, functional mushrooms offer benefits to optimize body and brain function due to them
  being antioxidants, anti-virals, and anti-microbials.
* ### Are functional mushrooms the same as magic mushrooms? Will they make me trip?
  
  While we think the mushrooms in our blend are perfectly magical due to their health benefits, no
  they are not psychedelic or magic mushrooms and they will not make you trip. With over 10,000
  species of mushrooms out there, medicinal (or functional mushrooms) are distinct from magic and
  have absolutely no psychedelic effects whatsoever.
* ### Are you certified gluten-free? Vegan?
  
  We are currently working on getting certified gluten free and vegan but we can absolutely assure
  you that all of our ingredients are gluten free and vegan.
* ### Are you organic?
  
  Our mushroom blend and our fiber blend are 100% organic.
* ### How should I use it?
  
  RYZE is a ready to drink beverage. Stir it into 8-10 oz. of hot water or use a mini-frother to
  make it extra foamy and frothy! Nut and non-dairy milks blend very nicely for an even creamier
  texture. Add natural sweeteners to taste.

# Stan & Joyce Orchard

Trying to figure it out since 1975.

[[Our Newest Neighbor]][9]

## [Our Newest Neighbor][10]

Mom decided to rest outside our living room window.

[[Unbearable Visitor]][11]

## [Unbearable Visitor][12]

This big guy wandered in at sunset. No matter how much I yelled he just looked at me as if to say,
'relax, dude. I'll leave when I'm ready.' Uppity jerk.

[[Fuzzy Antler Time]][13]

## [Fuzzy Antler Time][14]

These two guys and some of their friends stopped by early this morning. Always fascinated by their
seasonal changes, summer coats and new antlers coming in. Nature is always the best show in town.

[[Gruesome Find]][15]

## [Gruesome Find][16]

Found this in our front yard this morning. An eagle? A hawk? Not sure. A coyote or something else
caught it on that little rise then chewed on it until abandoning it where it is now. Gruesome yet
fascinating.

[[Hoping For Sheds]][17]

## [Hoping For Sheds][18]

We had about 20 of our furry friends stop by this afternoon. Most were cows but a few young bulls as
well. The guy in front still has his antlers, but the guy in back has already dropped his. We'll be
out looking.

[[Firewood Season Begins]][19]

## [Firewood Season Begins][20]

Changed the oil in the splitter and split one of the rounds we cut last fall. Should be done by
August. Now, I need a nap.

[[Bull In The Woods]][21]

## [Bull In The Woods][22]

Spotted this guy in the watershed at the end of our road on my walk today. Hasn’t dropped his rack
yet and his winter coat is still shaggy. That will all change soon.

[[Snow Day!]][23]

## [Snow Day!][24]

First halfway serious snow around here in the past two years. Limbs are cracking, trees snapping.
Haven't seen this in a while. Hopefully it will be gone soon.

[[Some Friends Stopped By]][25]

## [Some Friends Stopped By][26]

These critters and around 30+ of their friends wandered through. After more than 40 years they still
fascinate us. Wonder what they think of us?

[[A Life Illuminated]][27]

## [A Life Illuminated][28]

On this day long ago in the Territory of Alaska on the darkest day of the year, a child was born.
She became and is still the light of my life. We’re both amazed and grateful to still be here. Merry
Christmas everyone!

Spotted this guy in the watershed at the end of our road on my walk today. Hasn’t dropped his rack
yet and his winter coat is still shaggy. That will all change soon.

[[Snow Day!]][23]

## [Snow Day!][24]

First halfway serious snow around here in the past two years. Limbs are cracking, trees snapping.
Haven't seen this in a while. Hopefully it will be gone soon.

[[Some Friends Stopped By]][25]

## [Some Friends Stopped By][26]

These critters and around 30+ of their friends wandered through. After more than 40 years they still
fascinate us. Wonder what they think of us?

[[A Life Illuminated]][27]

## [A Life Illuminated][28]

On this day long ago in the Territory of Alaska on the darkest day of the year, a child was born.
She became and is still the light of my life. We’re both amazed and grateful to still be here. Merry
Christmas everyone!

# Stan & Joyce Orchard

Trying to figure it out since 1975.

[[Our Newest Neighbor]][9]

## [Our Newest Neighbor][10]

Mom decided to rest outside our living room window.

[[Unbearable Visitor]][11]

## [Unbearable Visitor][12]

This big guy wandered in at sunset. No matter how much I yelled he just looked at me as if to say,
'relax, dude. I'll leave when I'm ready.' Uppity jerk.

[[Fuzzy Antler Time]][13]

## [Fuzzy Antler Time][14]

These two guys and some of their friends stopped by early this morning. Always fascinated by their
seasonal changes, summer coats and new antlers coming in. Nature is always the best show in town.

[[Gruesome Find]][15]

## [Gruesome Find][16]

Found this in our front yard this morning. An eagle? A hawk? Not sure. A coyote or something else
caught it on that little rise then chewed on it until abandoning it where it is now. Gruesome yet
fascinating.

[[Hoping For Sheds]][17]

## [Hoping For Sheds][18]

We had about 20 of our furry friends stop by this afternoon. Most were cows but a few young bulls as
well. The guy in front still has his antlers, but the guy in back has already dropped his. We'll be
out looking.

[[Firewood Season Begins]][19]

## [Firewood Season Begins][20]

Changed the oil in the splitter and split one of the rounds we cut last fall. Should be done by
August. Now, I need a nap.

[[Bull In The Woods]][21]

## [Bull In The Woods][22]

Spotted this guy in the watershed at the end of our road on my walk today. Hasn’t dropped his rack
yet and his winter coat is still shaggy. That will all change soon.

Haven't seen this in a while. Hopefully it will be gone soon.

fascinate us. Wonder what they think of us?

She became and is still the light of my life. We’re both amazed and grateful to still be here. Merry
Christmas everyone!

## ****

# **DẪN ĐẦU VỀ SẢN XUẤT **
# **CƠ KHÍ & CÔNG NGHIỆP HỖ TRỢ TẠI VIỆT NAM**

Tập đoàn Công nghiệp Trường Hải – THACO INDUSTRIES là Tập đoàn thành viên của THACO, hoạt động trong
lĩnh vực sản xuất, kinh doanh các giải pháp công nghiệp, sản phẩm cơ khí chế tạo và công nghiệp hỗ
trợ.

Tập đoàn phát triển dựa trên nền tảng công nghiệp và số hóa với mô hình sản xuất tập trung, quy mô
lớn tại Chu Lai (TP. Đà Nẵng) và Bình Cơ (TP. Hồ Chí Minh). Hoạt động sản xuất, kinh doanh được thực
hiện xuyên suốt theo chuỗi giá trị: Kinh doanh và R&D, Sản xuất, Thi công lắp đặt, Bảo hành và Sửa
chữa.

Thông qua chiến lược tự phát triển, hợp tác, liên kết và liên doanh theo thông lệ ngành và quốc tế,
THACO INDUSTRIES cung cấp sản phẩm có hàm lượng công nghệ cao, đảm bảo tiêu chuẩn quốc tế với giá
thành cạnh tranh, đáp ứng yêu cầu riêng biệt của khách hàng.

## THACO INDUSTRIES
## **Lĩnh vực hoạt động**

[linh kiện phụ tùng ô tô]

### Linh kiện phụ tùng ô tô

THACO INDUSTRIES chuyên sâu trong hoạt động thiết kế, thí – thử nghiệm, phát triển sản phẩm, sản
xuất và cung cấp linh kiện, cụm linh kiện, phụ tùng ô tô cho các nhà sản xuất lắp ráp ô tô trong
nước và quốc tế. Sản phẩm đáp ứng tiêu chuẩn kỹ thuật khắt khe của từng thương hiệu, được xuất khẩu
sang các thị trường như: Mỹ, Canada, Úc, Nga, Hàn Quốc, Nhật Bản...

[semi trailers]

### Sơ mi rơ moóc

Thaco Trailers - Thương hiệu sơ mi rơ moóc hàng đầu Việt Nam với danh mục sản phẩm đa dạng chủng
loại: sơ mi rơ moóc xương, sơ mi rơ moóc sàn, sơ mi rơ moóc ben, sơ mi rơ moóc thùng và sơ mi rơ
moóc chuyên dụng... đáp ứng tiêu chuẩn thị trường nội địa và quốc tế. Các sản phẩm đã được xuất khẩu
sang các thị trường Mỹ, Úc, Canada, Mexico,...

[gia công cơ khí]

### Gia công cơ khí

Với kho thép hơn 100.000 tấn cùng hệ thống dây chuyền công nghệ tiên tiến nhập khẩu từ Đức, Thụy Sĩ,
Nhật Bản và Hàn Quốc, THACO INDUSTRIES trở thành đối tác chiến lược của nhiều doanh nghiệp lớn như
Doosan Vina, Makitech, Agata, Three Star; đồng thời, cung ứng sản phẩm khuôn mẫu chất lượng cao và
xuất khẩu linh kiện gia công cơ khí sang các thị trường Mỹ, Úc, Hàn Quốc, Canada,...

[Thiết bị công nghiệp]

### Thiết bị công nghiệp

Sở hữu năng lực sản xuất và gia công OEM thiết bị công nghiệp, kết cấu siêu trường siêu trọng hàng
đầu Việt Nam, THACO INDUSTRIES cung ứng giải pháp trọn gói "All-in-one" phục vụ đa dạng lĩnh vực:
sản xuất lắp ráp ô tô, khai khoáng, xây dựng, nông nghiệp, logistic,... đáp ứng tối đa nhu cầu thị
trường trong nước và xuất khẩu .

[Commercial & Household equipment]

### Thiết bị dân dụng

THACO INDUSTRIES sản xuất và cung cấp các thiết bị, linh kiện phục vụ lĩnh vực dân dụng như: linh
vật mascot, máy chạy bộ, xe đẩy, pallet nhựa, bồn nhựa, chậu cây... đáp ứng nhu cầu đa dạng của
khách hàng. Nhiều sản phẩm đã được xuất khẩu sang các thị trường: Mỹ, Canada, Úc, Nhật Bản, Hàn
Quốc,...

[high-tech industry]

### Thiết bị công nghệ cao

THACO INDUSTRIES nghiên cứu, phát triển và sản xuất linh kiện, thiết bị điện – điện tử công nghiệp;
dây chuyền, thiết bị tự động hóa & điều khiển thông minh (Robot công nghiệp, AGV, AMR, UAV, Drone…)
cùng các giải pháp nhà máy thông minh, đáp ứng xu hướng chuyển đổi số và sản xuất công nghiệp hiện
đại.

### Linh kiện phụ tùng ô tô

THACO INDUSTRIES chuyên sâu trong hoạt động thiết kế, thí – thử nghiệm, phát triển sản phẩm, sản
xuất và cung cấp linh kiện, cụm linh kiện, phụ tùng ô tô cho các nhà sản xuất lắp ráp ô tô trong
nước và quốc tế. Sản phẩm đáp ứng tiêu chuẩn kỹ thuật khắt khe của từng thương hiệu, được xuất khẩu
sang các thị trường như: Mỹ, Canada, Úc, Nga, Hàn Quốc, Nhật Bản...

[semi trailers]

### Sơ mi rơ moóc

Thaco Trailers - Thương hiệu sơ mi rơ moóc hàng đầu Việt Nam với danh mục sản phẩm đa dạng chủng
loại: sơ mi rơ moóc xương, sơ mi rơ moóc sàn, sơ mi rơ moóc ben, sơ mi rơ moóc thùng và sơ mi rơ
moóc chuyên dụng... đáp ứng tiêu chuẩn thị trường nội địa và quốc tế. Các sản phẩm đã được xuất khẩu
sang các thị trường Mỹ, Úc, Canada, Mexico,...

[gia công cơ khí]

### Gia công cơ khí

Với kho thép hơn 100.000 tấn cùng hệ thống dây chuyền công nghệ tiên tiến nhập khẩu từ Đức, Thụy Sĩ,
Nhật Bản và Hàn Quốc, THACO INDUSTRIES trở thành đối tác chiến lược của nhiều doanh nghiệp lớn như
Doosan Vina, Makitech, Agata, Three Star; đồng thời, cung ứng sản phẩm khuôn mẫu chất lượng cao và
xuất khẩu linh kiện gia công cơ khí sang các thị trường Mỹ, Úc, Hàn Quốc, Canada,...

[Thiết bị công nghiệp]

### Thiết bị công nghiệp

Sở hữu năng lực sản xuất và gia công OEM thiết bị công nghiệp, kết cấu siêu trường siêu trọng hàng
đầu Việt Nam, THACO INDUSTRIES cung ứng giải pháp trọn gói "All-in-one" phục vụ đa dạng lĩnh vực:
sản xuất lắp ráp ô tô, khai khoáng, xây dựng, nông nghiệp, logistic,... đáp ứng tối đa nhu cầu thị
trường trong nước và xuất khẩu .

[Commercial & Household equipment]

### Thiết bị dân dụng

THACO INDUSTRIES sản xuất và cung cấp các thiết bị, linh kiện phục vụ lĩnh vực dân dụng như: linh
vật mascot, máy chạy bộ, xe đẩy, pallet nhựa, bồn nhựa, chậu cây... đáp ứng nhu cầu đa dạng của
khách hàng. Nhiều sản phẩm đã được xuất khẩu sang các thị trường: Mỹ, Canada, Úc, Nhật Bản, Hàn
Quốc,...

[high-tech industry]

### Thiết bị công nghệ cao

THACO INDUSTRIES nghiên cứu, phát triển và sản xuất linh kiện, thiết bị điện – điện tử công nghiệp;
dây chuyền, thiết bị tự động hóa & điều khiển thông minh (Robot công nghiệp, AGV, AMR, UAV, Drone…)
cùng các giải pháp nhà máy thông minh, đáp ứng xu hướng chuyển đổi số và sản xuất công nghiệp hiện
đại.

chữa.

## What is Case Study Solution?

[Case Study Solution][Case Study Solution]Case Study Solution is the solution or the answer to the
problems presented in a case study. The objective of a case study solution is to analyze the
situation presented in the case and reach a solution or recommendation. Case Studies are the real
life business scenarios where students are expected to react to the situation presented in the case
and reach real life conclusions.

### Case Study Help

A case study is one of the research technique that is depended on a single case. The case studies
are widespread and found in many subjects like [political][43], [sociology][44],
anthropology, [business][45], clinical science, social
work, [educational][46] and [administrative][47] science, the case study doesn’t take a population
or sample to study, rather than the research emphasized on a single case, to make their observations
within the long period of time. Besides, case studies are very valuable in the primary phases of
research when the objective is to discover the [ideas][48], trials, and perfect measurement tools.

## Where can I find a case analysis for Harvard Business School or HBR Cases?

You can find Harvard case solutions (HBR Case Solutions) at TheCaseSolutions.com - Number 1 website
in Case Study Solutions. All solutions are done from scratch and are plagiarism free. Turnitin
Reports are also provided as proof of originality of the work being done.

## What is Online Case Study?

[Online Case Study][Online Case Study]A methodology of creating a systematic research related to any
professional experience or any specific incident is commonly referred to as case study. In other
words, a case study is a method of encouraging students of different courses to participate in the
real life scenarios and have a practical experience of professional life through assessing it from
different perspectives. Case study is subjective and descriptive analysis of a group, person or any
event.

Online case studies are available on the internet for students to practice writing a report on a
given case study and to learn more about the different types of case studies available. It is also
available for educators to provide students with different and informative case study and to educate
them through it.

As students are not practically involved in the professional life and have only bookish knowledge
thus, to give them a practical and professional life experience, almost every university incorporate
such case studies in their courses. This gives the student an advantage of learning through real
life scenarios.

The case studies are mostly based on the real life scenarios that had happened in the past. For
instance, the corporate failures of the past of famous companies may formed a case study for
business students.

Turn young dandelion leaves and freshly dug roots into two simple wild-food dishes with common
kitchen ingredients. Dandelions may be one of the most familiar plants in the yard, yet many new
foragers still wonder what to do with them after harvest. That is where these two easy dandelion
recipes come in. The first recipe combines tender dandelion leaves with butter, garlic, and lemon.
Meanwhile, the second turns small dandelion roots into tangy refrigerator pickles. Both recipes make
small portions, so you can try dandelion without preparing a large batch. I first made pickled
dandelion roots while living in Alaska, and they quickly became one of my favorite wild snacks.

[July 9, 2026][43] [rpolipnick][44] [Foraging][45], [Foraging Wild Edible Plants and Mushrooms][46],
[Wild Edible Plants Foraging and Identification Guides][47]

Oxeye daisy is one of the most recognizable wildflowers in fields, meadows, roadsides, and open
sunny places. Most people know the look right away. A bright yellow center. White petals. A simple
daisy shape that feels familiar from childhood. However, oxeye daisy is more than just a pretty
flower. It is also a useful plant for beginner foragers to understand because it is common, easy to
notice, and sometimes used in small culinary ways. It also comes with an important warning. Oxeye
daisy is considered invasive or noxious in many areas, including Washington State. Because of that,
this is not a plant to spread, plant, scatter, move around, or encourage. If you harvest it where it

Turn young dandelion leaves and freshly dug roots into two simple wild-food dishes with common
kitchen ingredients. Dandelions may be one of the most familiar plants in the yard, yet many new
foragers still wonder what to do with them after harvest. That is where these two easy dandelion
recipes come in. The first recipe combines tender dandelion leaves with butter, garlic, and lemon.
Meanwhile, the second turns small dandelion roots into tangy refrigerator pickles. Both recipes make
small portions, so you can try dandelion without preparing a large batch. I first made pickled
dandelion roots while living in Alaska, and they quickly became one of my favorite wild snacks.

[July 9, 2026][43] [rpolipnick][44] [Foraging][45], [Foraging Wild Edible Plants and Mushrooms][46],
[Wild Edible Plants Foraging and Identification Guides][47]

Oxeye daisy is one of the most recognizable wildflowers in fields, meadows, roadsides, and open
sunny places. Most people know the look right away. A bright yellow center. White petals. A simple
daisy shape that feels familiar from childhood. However, oxeye daisy is more than just a pretty
flower. It is also a useful plant for beginner foragers to understand because it is common, easy to
notice, and sometimes used in small culinary ways. It also comes with an important warning. Oxeye
daisy is considered invasive or noxious in many areas, including Washington State. Because of that,
this is not a plant to spread, plant, scatter, move around, or encourage. If you harvest it where it

# The Wild Mushroom Dried Mushroom Mixes Manufacturer

Dive into the rich, earthy flavors of The Wild Mushroom Dried Mushroom Mix, where handpicked wild
mushrooms like morels, chanterelles, and porcini come together in a vibrant seasonal blend. Gently
air-dried to lock in their natural taste and nutrients, these mushrooms bring a burst of umami to
soups, sauces, risottos, and beyond. Sourced from the lush forests of the Pacific Northwest, this
mix is as nourishing as it is delicious, packed with protein, B vitamins, and essential minerals to
support your health. Whether you’re a home cook or a gourmet chef, this mushroom mix transforms
everyday meals into extraordinary culinary experiences.

## Top The Wild Mushroom Dried Mushroom Mixes

### The Wild Mushroom Co. – Dried Gourmet Mix (12 oz)

This mix offers a blend of European wild mushrooms in a 12‑ounce pouch, delivering strong umami
flavour for sauces, risottos, and hearty soups.

[ Check Price ][4]

### The Wild Mushroom Co. – Gourmet Mushroom Mix (454 g)

A large 454‑gram pack with yellow boletes, oyster mushrooms, portobello, and porcini, ideal for
frequent cooking or sharing among multiple households.

[ Check Price ][5]

### Roland Premium Dried Mixed Wild Mushrooms

A well‑known brand offering a premium wild mushroom mix in dried form, great when you want a
dependable quality in smaller quantities.

[ Check Price ][6]

Wild mushrooms bring a burst of forest flavor and rich nutrition to any meal, perfectly captured in
a variety of dried gourmet mixes.


## Gourmet Wild Mushroom Mixes

Experience the deep, earthy taste of carefully hand-harvested wild mushrooms like morels,
chanterelles, lobster mushrooms, and porcini, dried to preserve their unique aroma and flavor. These
mixes are perfect for enhancing pasta, risotto, soups, and sauces with a natural umami kick.

## Exotic Mushroom Blends

Discover rare treasures like black trumpets, hedgehogs, matsutake, and shiitake combined in seasonal
assortments that elevate your cooking with complex textures and vibrant tastes, all vegan,
gluten-free, and sourced from pristine Pacific Northwest forests.

## Versatile Culinary Mushrooms

These dried mushrooms rehydrate quickly to add gourmet flair to a variety of dishes, from hearty
stews to elegant sauces, offering an easy way to incorporate protein, B vitamins, and essential
minerals into your diet.

### Reviews

“Using the Wild Mushroom Dried Mix completely transformed my cooking. The flavors were so intense
and fresh, it felt like I was foraging in the forest myself. I made a mushroom risotto that
impressed all my guests, and the variety of mushrooms added amazing depth. Highly recommend!”
**— Sarah Jenkins**

“I’ve been cooking with dried mushrooms for years, but this mix is by far the best. The mushrooms
rehydrate beautifully, and the blend of morels, chanterelles, and porcini was perfectly balanced.
It’s gluten-free and vegan, which fits my diet, and the quality is outstanding.”
**— Michael Lee**

“The rich taste and texture of these wild mushrooms made my soups and sauces next level. I loved how
easy it was to use them—just soak and cook. You can really tell they’re wild-harvested from the
Pacific Northwest; the freshness and earthiness come through in every bite.”
**— Emily Carter**

## The Wild Mushroom FAQ

### What types of mushrooms are included in The Wild Mushroom Dried Mushroom Mixes?

The mixes typically contain a variety of wild mushrooms such as porcini, shiitake, oyster, morel,
and chanterelle, offering a rich and complex flavor profile.

### How do I rehydrate dried mushrooms before cooking?

Simply soak the dried mushrooms in warm water for about 20 to 30 minutes until they become soft,
then drain and use them in your recipes. The soaking liquid can also be used as a flavorful broth.

### How should I store dried mushroom mixes to keep them fresh?

Store dried mushrooms in an airtight container in a cool, dry, and dark place, such as a pantry, to
maintain their flavor and prevent moisture absorption.

### Can I use dried mushrooms directly in soups or sauces without soaking?

While you can add dried mushrooms directly, soaking them first improves texture and helps release
their full flavor into the dish.

### Are these mushroom mixes suitable for vegetarian or vegan diets?

Yes, dried mushroom mixes are 100% plant-based and naturally suitable for vegetarian and vegan
diets.

### How long do dried mushrooms last before they expire?

When stored properly, dried mushrooms can last up to one year or more without losing quality.

### Can I use the leftover soaking water from dried mushrooms in cooking?

Absolutely! The soaking water absorbs mushroom flavors and can be used as a delicious stock for
soups, stews, or risottos.

## Gourmet Veloute (Dried Gourmet Mushroom Mix)

When stored properly, dried mushrooms can last up to one year or more without losing quality.

### Can I use the leftover soaking water from dried mushrooms in cooking?

Absolutely! The soaking water absorbs mushroom flavors and can be used as a delicious stock for
soups, stews, or risottos.

pages.text: [Skip to content][1] [[The Wild Mushroom]][2] [[The Wild Mushroom]][3] # The Wild Mushroom Dried Mushroom Mixes Manufacturer Dive into the rich, earthy flavors of The Wild Mushroom Dried Mushroom Mix, where handpicked wild mushrooms like morels, chanterelles, and porcini come together in a vibrant seasonal blend. Gently air-dried to lock in their natural taste and nutrients, these mushrooms bring a burst of umami to soups, sauces, risottos, and beyond. Sourced from the lush forests of the Pacific Northwest, this mix is as nourishing as it is delicious, packed with protein, B vitamins, and essential minerals to support your health. Whether you’re a home cook or a gourmet chef, this mushroom mix transforms everyday meals into extraordinary culinary experiences. ## Top The Wild Mushroom Dried Mushroom Mixes ### The Wild Mushroom Co. – Dried Gourmet Mix (12 oz) This mix offers a blend of European wild mushrooms in a 12‑ounce pouch, delivering strong umami flavour for sauces, risottos, and hearty soups. [ Check Price ][4] ### The Wild Mushroom Co. – Gourmet Mushroom Mix (454 g) A large 454‑gram pack with yellow boletes, oyster mushrooms, portobello, and porcini, ideal for frequent cooking or sharing among multiple households. [ Check Price ][5] ### Roland Premium Dried Mixed Wild Mushrooms A well‑known brand offering a premium wild mushroom mix in dried form, great when you want a dependable quality in smaller quantities. [ Check Price ][6] Wild mushrooms bring a burst of forest flavor and rich nutrition to any meal, perfectly captured in a variety of dried gourmet mixes. ## Gourmet Wild Mushroom Mixes Experience the deep, earthy taste of carefully hand-harvested wild mushrooms like morels, chanterelles, lobster mushrooms, and porcini, dried to preserve their unique aroma and flavor. These mixes are perfect for enhancing pasta, risotto, soups, and sauces with a natural umami kick. ## Exotic Mushroom Blends Discover rare treasures like black trumpets, hedgehogs, matsutake, and shiitake combined in seasonal assortments that elevate your cooking with complex textures and vibrant tastes, all vegan, gluten-free, and sourced from pristine Pacific Northwest forests. ## Versatile Culinary Mushrooms These dried mushrooms rehydrate quickly to add gourmet flair to a variety of dishes, from hearty stews to elegant sauces, offering an easy way to incorporate protein, B vitamins, and essential minerals into your diet. ### Reviews “Using the Wild Mushroom Dried Mix completely transformed my cooking. The flavors were so intense and fresh, it felt like I was foraging in the forest myself. I made a mushroom risotto that impressed all my guests, and the variety of mushrooms added amazing depth. Highly recommend!” **— Sarah Jenkins** “I’ve been cooking with dried mushrooms for years, but this mix is by far the best. I loved how easy it was to use them—just soak and cook. You can really tell they’re wild-harvested from the Pacific Northwest; the freshness and earthiness come through in every bite.” **— Emily Carter** ## The Wild Mushroom FAQ ### What types of mushrooms are included in The Wild Mushroom Dried Mushroom Mixes? The mixes typically contain a variety of wild mushrooms such as porcini, shiitake, oyster, morel, and chanterelle, offering a rich and complex flavor profile. ### How do I rehydrate dried mushrooms before cooking? Simply soak the dried mushrooms in warm water for about 20 to 30 minutes until they become soft, then drain and use them in your recipes. The soaking liquid can also be used as a flavorful broth. ### How should I store dried mushroom mixes to keep them fresh? Store dried mushrooms in an airtight container in a cool, dry, and dark place, such as a pantry, to maintain their flavor and prevent moisture absorption. ### Can I use dried mushrooms directly in soups or sauces without soaking? While you can add dried mushrooms directly, soaking them first improves texture and helps release their full flavor into the dish. ### Are these mushroom mixes suitable for vegetarian or vegan diets? Yes, dried mushroom mixes are 100% plant-based and naturally suitable for vegetarian and vegan diets. ### How long do dried mushrooms last before they expire? When stored properly, dried mushrooms can last up to one year or more without losing quality. ### Can I use the leftover soaking water from dried mushrooms in cooking? Absolutely! The Challenge

## The agri-food industry runs on opacity and manual effort.

01

### Information Asymmetry

Buyers and suppliers operate with wildly different levels of market visibility. Pricing,
availability, and quality data are fragmented, outdated, or locked behind intermediaries.

02

### Trust & Verification Gap

Finding reliable counterparties requires years of relationship-building, trade shows, and manual due
diligence. Verification is slow, expensive, and often unreliable.

03

### Execution Bottleneck

Even when opportunities are identified, execution remains manual -- outreach, negotiation, logistics
coordination, compliance, and follow-ups consume enormous time and resources.

OUR VISION

## Agri-food trade should work for everyone in it.

We believe that transparent data, verified networks, and intelligent automation can eliminate the
friction that holds global food trade back. Every buyer deserves fair prices. Every supplier
deserves market access. Every transaction should be efficient.

Data LayerNetwork LayerAI Layer

Together, these three layers form the foundation for a fundamentally better way to trade food
globally.

Manufacturing models

## Three ways to make your product

### Private label

You commission a manufacturer to produce a formula adapted to your brand, packaged under your name.
Use it when you want a differentiated product without owning a factory. The formula is typically
co-developed and can be licensed exclusively, with the manufacturer retaining process know-how and
you owning the brand and commercial rights.

[Browse private label manufacturers ][42]

### White label

You select an existing product the manufacturer already produces and apply your branding. Use it
when speed and low MOQs matter more than uniqueness. The formula stays with the manufacturer and may
be sold to other brands in parallel, so you carry less development risk but accept that competitors
may shelve a near-identical product.

[Browse white label manufacturers ][43]

### Contract manufacturing

You hand the manufacturer a complete specification or formula and they produce it to order. Use it
when you have proprietary IP, regulated processes, or volumes that justify dedicated production. You
own the formula, the manufacturer owns the capacity, and the commercial terms are usually structured
around guaranteed minimum runs.

Manufacturing models

## Three ways to make your product

### Private label

You commission a manufacturer to produce a formula adapted to your brand, packaged under your name.
Use it when you want a differentiated product without owning a factory. The formula is typically
co-developed and can be licensed exclusively, with the manufacturer retaining process know-how and
you owning the brand and commercial rights.

[Browse private label manufacturers ][42]

### White label

You select an existing product the manufacturer already produces and apply your branding. Use it
when speed and low MOQs matter more than uniqueness. The formula stays with the manufacturer and may
be sold to other brands in parallel, so you carry less development risk but accept that competitors
may shelve a near-identical product.

[Browse white label manufacturers ][43]

### Contract manufacturing

You hand the manufacturer a complete specification or formula and they produce it to order. Use it
when you have proprietary IP, regulated processes, or volumes that justify dedicated production. You
own the formula, the manufacturer owns the capacity, and the commercial terms are usually structured
around guaranteed minimum runs.
